text:
kevin_partners: Quick sync — vendor pinged: late ABI change in Gaudi driver that can break marketplace images. Affects Gaudi and possibly MI300 images. Rolling out week of Apr 4. @alex_hw do we have a mitigation?

alex_hw: Saw changelog. It's a loader symbol rename; current kernel module ABI still compatible but vendor changed userland lib. Short-term: run a compat-sidecar that bundles vendor lib and LD_PRELOAD. Perf hit unknown.

julia_w: timeline from vendor?

carlos_m: Vendor says rollout starts Mon and enforced in their image builder; existing images will fail the runtime healthcheck. They gave a test artifact: gs://vendor/gaudi/abi-test.tar.gz

kevin_partners: OK. Proposed immediate actions:
1) Validate vendor artifact in our staging marketplace images
2) POC compat-sidecar that LD_PRELOADs vendor lib
3) Canary deploy on Dedicated and Hosted canary pool
4) Comms plan for SI + marketplace customers

erin_sre: Add gating: marketplace ingestion should fail if compat tests fail. Also add a rollback tag: 'gaudi-legacy' we can flip.

alex_hw: POC steps (short):
```
# unpack test artifact
tar xzf abi-test.tar.gz
LD_PRELOAD=./vendor_lib.so ./runtime-selftest --targets=gaudi
```
I'll run perf baseline after POC. Need 2 Gaudi cards in staging for 48h.

compat-bot: ci/gaudi-compat-tests failed (0/10) — logs: /ci/gaudi/5990011223

carlos_m: If compat-sidecar is too slow, fallback is to pin marketplace images to 'toolchain=v1' until vendor backports.

kevin_partners: Action owners: @alex_hw POC (ETA Wed EOD), @carlos_m gate + rollback tag, @julia_w customer comms + SI heads-up. I'll schedule a 30m dry run Tue 09:00 PT with vendor and SI reps. :calendar:

julia_w: noted, will draft comms and add SI recipients.

erin_sre: I'll prep canary config and ensure automatic rollback on error 5xx.

kevin_partners: Thanks. If anyone sees vendor docs updates post this thread ping here. :thumbsup:
